subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose provider-side workspace/server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and what default-off gates, provider scopes, requester authorization, and gateway permission boundary should be required?
rationale: The feature would let agents mutate Slack workspaces and Discord servers; current main has partial Discord support but no Slack admin gate or accepted cross-provider authority model.

options.title: Approve gated provider-owned channel creation
options.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, then implement Slack creation and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

options.title: Narrow to Discord CLI first
options.body: Treat the open Discord CLI PR as the only near-term work and defer Slack channel creation until a separate product/security decision.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep workspace and server provisioning in provider-native admin tools or external scripts unless stronger demand appears.

recommendation.title: Approve gated provider-owned channel creation
recommendation.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, then implement Slack creation and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the prior review and has the strongest visible routing signal across the current CLI/message-action surfaces.
